item.title: Spider Buddy 0.9.0
item.description:
## What's new
- **Signed and notarized by Apple.** Spider Buddy now opens like any other app — no more right-click → Open on first launch. - **Surer footing.** Its legs find real ground in corners, at the lip of a step, across gaps and round window edges, instead of stretching out to ground they couldn't reach.
**One-time step:** because the app is now signed differently, macOS may ask you to allow Screen Recording (and Accessibility, if you'd granted it) again after this update.
